text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Graca Machel, widow of the late Mozambican President Samora Machel, will receive an honorary doctorate from Britain's Essex University next week, in recognition of her work in support of the rights of children throughout the world. She will be accompanied on her visit to Britain by President Nelson Mandela of South Africa.
- President Joaquim Chissano of Mozambique will be guest of honour at an international conference on democracy, development and good governance, to be held in Zanzibar at the weekend.
